description: A crown of clear ice spires on a frozen base. It does not melt, and it does not like being held.
lore: Bare hands stick to it and come away short, so it travels in straw like an egg and every buyer is warned twice. A third of them try it anyway.

Most go to people who cannot sleep warm. There is a woman two fires east who keeps one under her cot and the shutter open in every season, and she has been asked, kindly, whether that is not a hard way to live. She says the cold was the last thing she felt on the other side and the first thing she lost in [[lore/the_waking|the grass]], and that a person is allowed one souvenir. Then she asks you to shut the door on your way out, from the outside.
